description: One row per analytics/error destination the SPA may initialise. type picks the adapter (MATOMO|GA4|POSTHOG|SENTRY|CUSTOM); not enum-constrained because schema/v1/_update returns 501. enabled is false on create so an unseeded env stays dark. The shim reads the state tenant and the active city tenant; a city row overrides the state row of the same code. settings and adapter are open forward-compat buckets. adapter.callTemplates is DATA ONLY, never eval'd. x-ref-schema omitted on purpose.

code.description: Permanent identity key. Also the MDMS uniqueIdentifier - immutable after create.

type.description: Adapter key. v1 catalog: MATOMO | GA4 | POSTHOG | SENTRY | CUSTOM. Not enum-constrained (see schema description).

enabled.description: Master on/off for this destination. The Configurator Create form writes false unless the field is named exactly 'active', so a newly created row is born OFF.

scriptUrl.description: https only; hostname must match the ops-controlled ANALYTICS_SCRIPT_HOSTS allowlist in globalConfigs. MDMS cannot widen that allowlist.

siteId.description: STRING, not integer - preserves leading zeros and non-numeric vendor ids.

globalName.description: CUSTOM only. Name of the global array the call templates are pushed onto. Must match /^_[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,40}$/.

disablePageViews.description: Negative polarity on purpose: the Configurator Create form writes false for every boolean not named 'active', and MDMS never applies JSON-Schema defaults. A positively-named trackPageViews with default true would be created as false.

surfaces.description: Comma-separated: citizen,employee. Empty/absent = both. A STRING, not an array: an empty array from the UI serialises to {} through Kong and the validator then rejects it.

scrubPatterns.description: Comma-separated extra regex sources. APPENDED to the built-in scrubbers, never replacing them.

adapter.description: CUSTOM only: { scriptUrl?, globalName?, callTemplates: { init?, pageView?, event? } }.
